text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH error-rate on inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1 (5xx). AlertID PD#A1B2C3. First seen 00:12 UTC.

carlos (oncall): acked — I'm on it. pinging logs + checking routing.

liam: I'm seeing a spike in 502/503s from gateway -> model-backend-1. 00:11-00:13 window shows timeouts and upstream reset. sample log:```
2026-03-14T00:11:42Z gateway inference-gateway-prod-eu-west1 ERROR upstream_read_timeout backend=model-backend-1 conn=45ms
2026-03-14T00:12:03Z gateway ERROR http2: stream error: code=NO_ERROR
```

maya: FWIW metrics show token-serving latency jumped ~3x and a surge in KV:cache-misses — possible kvcache eviction thrash. Not yet sure if it's load or memory leak.

carlos (oncall): status on customers? any 3rd-party pages?

emma (pm): AcmeCorp's support queue has a few screenshots of streaming chat failing (time out). They reported 00:10-00:13.

liam: rolling hotfix attempt: increasing model-backend-1 replicas by +2 in eu-west1, also enabling fallback to model-quantized-v1 for non-streaming requests. running:```sh
redwoodctl infra scale pool model-backend-1 --region eu-west1 --add 2
redwoodctl routing promote model-quantized-v1 --traffic 0.15 --region eu-west1
```

oncall-bot: command accepted, scaling initiated. k8s rollout starting.

eng-runtime: recommend we also flip gateway fallback policy for 10 minutes to region fallback eu-central1 if error-rate remains > 5% for 2 consecutive minutes. Applying temporary policy now.

carlos (oncall): doing canary reroute to eu-central1 for 5% of traffic. will monitor 1m/5m error-rate.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: 5xx spike -> check KV cache, scale model pool, enable fallback. Link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/5xx-spike>

liam: logs after scale: backend queue length decreased but still seeing intermittent 502 from model-backend-1 at ~00:14. stack says "grpc: the connection is unavailable" in some shards.

maya: I'm attaching a quick heap/kv stats snapshot — looks like ephemeral memory pressure around 00:08-00:12 which aligns with a traffic burst from a single API key (key: ak_live_XX). Might be a customer replay or bot.

carlos (oncall): blocked list applied to that API key and rate-limited. also opened a support ticket for AcmeCorp.

eng-runtime: we've fully activated fallback to model-quantized-v1 for non-critical routes and bumped pool to +4. error-rate down from 18% -> 6% in last 3m. still above baseline but improving.

pagerduty-bot: PD#A1B2C3 acknowledged by carlos at 00:12:30 UTC. Escalation to eng-runtime at 00:13:45 UTC.

maya: action items: (1) keep fallback for 20m, (2) monitor for repeated bursts from offending API key, (3) follow up with infra team to run a memcheck on that model host.

carlos (oncall): handing off to maya for night shift monitoring (I'm stepping out). maya — you're now incident lead. :white_check_mark:

maya: taking lead. will update status in 10m or on significant change. setting incident severity: Sev2 (partial service degradation).

emma (pm): Notifying affected customers and drafting status page message. ETA for updated status: 00:35 UTC.

liam: temporary mitigation seems stable. keeping watch on 1m error-rate and tail latencies. if error-rate falls <2% for 10m we'll close PD.

mike (observability-bot): Current metrics snapshot: 1m 5xx=6.3%, 5m 5xx=9.4%, request-rate +120% vs baseline. KV-cache-miss rate normalized after fallback.

maya: closing notes: escalation complete, mitigations applied (scale + fallback + rate-limit), on-call handoff done. will follow up with post-incident writeup tomorrow.

sre-runbook-bot: Please remember to run the postmortem template: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/new>

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident thread moved to monitoring.
